title: 第二十九章 蚀骨鬼草
novel_title: 穿书被杀妻证道？魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
谢清猗目光锁定那株灵植，眸光一凛，厉声喝止。

    那弟子手悬在半空，错愕地回过头望向她。

    她微微摇头，裙摆拂动，向前走近一些，语气不容置疑：“不可碰。此物并非龙骨草，乃是形貌极其相似的‘蚀骨鬼草’。”她指尖轻指，“你们看，细看其叶脉，缺乏龙骨草特有的流莹。”

    不远处，已有几名结伴而行的散修手脚麻利地将几株相似的‘灵草’采下，正喜滋滋地端详手中的‘宝贝’。

    其中一名魁梧汉子听得谢清猗的话，当即不屑地嗤笑出声，斜眼瞥来：“蚀骨鬼草？呵，小丫头片子，信口开河！回家多学学再出来显摆吧！”

    他身旁的同伴也纷纷哄笑起来，语带讥讽：“如今看来，天极仙府的弟子，是一代不如一代。”

    “只怕这第一仙府的名头，也快到让贤的时候了！”一个吊梢眼的男修阴阳怪气地起哄。

    喧嚷间，一道馥郁香风飘然而至，一名瞧着约莫二十七八年纪，姿容风流的女子款步上前。她云鬓微松，眼波流转间自带一段媚意，目光先是黏腻地在沈江寒挺拔的身姿上转了一圈。

    才用那酥媚入骨的嗲音对着谢清猗问道：“小仙子，身上这仙品法衣可真真是难得，想必是哪位真尊座下的亲传高徒吧？不知令师尊号，可否说与姐姐听呀？”

    谢清猗连眼角余光都未扫向那女修，刚才对方那暗含审视的眼神她已尽收眼底，心中不喜，此刻更是懒得理会。

    也不知这些人什么来头，虽是散修，还是小心为妙，她掌心长剑倏然一转，挽起一道清冷弧光。下颌微抬，红唇轻启，背身面向天极弟子，声音清越：“天极仙府弟子听令！秘境之中，凡遇此草，一律禁止触碰。”

    “谨遵师叔之命！”身后传来弟子们毫无迟疑且整齐地回应。

    “师妹，”沈江寒抱着他那柄玉色本命剑，唇角轻勾，饶有兴味地扫了一眼那几个仍在嘲弄的散修，语带几分幸灾乐祸，“我倒是好奇，他们还需等上多久，才能‘见效’？”
content_en:
Xie Qingyi's eyes locked on the spiritual plant, his eyes narrowed, and he shouted sternly to stop.

    The disciple's hands were hanging in the air and he turned back to look at her in astonishment.

    She shook her head slightly, fluttered her skirt, walked closer, and said in an unquestionable tone: "Don't touch it. This thing is not dragon bone grass, but the 'Bone-Eroting Ghost Grass' with a very similar appearance." She pointed lightly with her fingertips, "Look, if you look carefully at the veins of its leaves, it lacks the unique fluidity of dragon bone grass."

    Not far away, several casual cultivators traveling together had quickly picked several similar 'spiritual grasses' and were happily looking at the 'treasures' in their hands.

    One of the burly men heard Xie Qingyi's words and immediately sneered disdainfully and glanced sideways: "Bone-eating ghost grass? Ha, little girl, you are talking nonsense! Go home and learn more before you come out to show off!"

    The companions beside him also burst into laughter and said sarcastically: "Now it seems that the disciples of Tianji Immortal Mansion are inferior to each other."

    "I'm afraid it's almost time for the No. 1 Immortal Mansion to give way to someone new!" A male cultivator who looked down on his head booed angrily.

    In the midst of the commotion, a fragrant wind floated over, and a graceful-looking woman who looked to be about twenty-seven or seventy-eight years old stepped forward. Her temples were slightly loosened, and her eyes were filled with charm. First, her eyes moved stickyly around Shen Jianghan's tall and upright figure.

    Then he asked Xie Qingyi with that charming whisper: "Little fairy, this fairy robe is really rare. I must be a direct disciple of some true master, right? I don't know your master's name. Can you tell me your master's name?"

    Xie Qingyi didn't even glance at the female cultivator from the corner of her eye. She had already seen the implicit scrutiny in her eyes just now. She was unhappy in her heart, and she couldn't be bothered to pay attention to it at this moment.

    She didn't know where these people came from. Even though they were casual cultivators, it was better to be careful. The long sword in her palm suddenly turned, creating a cold arc of light. He raised his chin slightly, opened his red lips slightly, turned his back to the disciples of Tianji, and said in a clear voice: "Disciples of Tianji Immortal Mansion, listen to the order! In the secret realm, it is forbidden to touch this grass whenever you encounter it."

    "I obey my uncle's order!" came the disciples from behind who responded without hesitation and neatly.

    "Junior sister," Shen Jianghan held his jade-colored natal sword, his lips curled up slightly, and he glanced at the few casual cultivators who were still mocking with interest, with a hint of gloating in his words, "I'm curious, how long do they have to wait before they can 'result'?"
